title: Decoded Two-Tape Machine
statement: Let $c$ be an effective two-work-tape machine code and let $\alpha$ be a binary string. The two-work-tape machine assigned to $\alpha$ by the $K$-machine construction associated with $c$ is equal to the underlying machine decoded from $\alpha$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is an effective two-work-tape machine code
replaced:
Let $c$ be an effective two-work-tape machine code and let $\alpha$ be a binary string.
The two-work-tape machine associated to the $k$-tape presentation of $c$ at $\alpha$ is
the underlying machine of the code decoded from $\alpha$.
